goal: Change the post code for member 40204 to LS28 4HG, then read the post code back off the contact screen
description: Updated member 40204's post code to LS28 4HG via the Contact Details screen (Save Details), then reopened the member record and Contact Details screen fresh and read the Post Code field back, confirming it shows LS28 4HG.
